Singapore Airlines invests $2 billion in cabin upgrades

Singapore Airlines is undertaking a cabin upgrade project costing over S$2 billion. The enhancements are designed to improve passenger comfort, privacy, entertainment, and personalization, including features like double beds and larger screens. The airline's interim profit has nearly halved due to increased fuel costs.
